Work independently, enjoy plenty of freedom, and hit the road every day? Become a Delivery Driver Jumbo in Amsterdam through Consolid and start working at Jumbo right away. Deliver groceries throughout the region in a varied and independent role. Wat bieden wij? €17.75 gross per hour from the age of 21, including holiday pay, statutory vacation days, and ADV allowance; 50% extra pay for working between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM; 100% extra pay on public holidays; 20 vacation days per year based on a full-time contract of 40 hours per week; Travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometre from 10.1 km up to a maximum of 35 km one-way; Pension plan; Meal allowance for late shifts; Part-time work available; A high level of independence during your working day; Driving a modern Jumbo delivery van; Career development opportunities within Jumbo and Consolid; Prospect of a permanent contract with Jumbo. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Jumbo | Start now | Amsterdam Start your working day at the Jumbo Hub in Amsterdam. Together with your colleagues, you check the daily schedule, prepare your route, and head out in a modern Jumbo delivery van. You will deliver groceries to customers at home and at business locations throughout Amsterdam. As a Delivery Driver, you are one of the faces of Jumbo. You deliver groceries safely, on time, and with a friendly attitude. Whether you are driving through busy streets, finding parking in the city centre, or carrying grocery crates upstairs, you remain professional and customer-focused. Thanks to your excellent service, every customer receives their order with a smile. No two working days are the same. You will drive different routes, visit a variety of locations, and meet many different customers throughout the day. After completing your route, you return to the hub and finish your shift together with your colleagues. What does a typical working day look like? You start at the Jumbo Hub in Amsterdam, check your route, and head out in a modern

delivery van. During your shift, you deliver groceries throughout Amsterdam and the surrounding area. Do I need experience? Previous delivery experience is not required. However, you must have at least 3 months of independent driving experience and hold a valid Category B driving licence (manual transmission). Can I work part-time? Yes, this is a part-time position. You must be available on at least 2 days per week, with availability on Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday or Saturday. Working on Saturdays is highly preferred. Working hours: Morning shifts between 6:00 AM and 3:00 PM; Afternoon and evening shifts between 3:00 PM and 11:00 PM; Shifts of approximately 6 to 7 hours; Available at least 2 days per week; Planning based on your availability. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Jumbo | Start now | Amsterdam Valid Category B driving licence (manual transmission); At least 3 months of independent driving experience; Good command of the English or Dutch language; Available at least 2 days per week; Saturday availability is highly preferred; Available for a minimum period of 6 months; Living in or near Amsterdam; In good physical condition.
